name: Nabla
short_description: Ambient AI assistant generating structured clinical notes in seconds with 35+ language support, deep EHR integrations, and zero patient data storage on servers.
long_description: Nabla is an ambient AI medical assistant that transforms clinical interactions into structured notes within seconds. The platform listens to patient-clinician conversations and generates clinical documentation (SOAP format) with automatic ICD-10 code suggestions. A key differentiator is Nabla's privacy model: audio, transcripts, and notes exist only in the clinician's browser and are never stored on Nabla's servers. The platform supports 35+ languages including Arabic, Mandarin, Spanish, French, Hindi, and Vietnamese. With 150+ health organizations and 85,000+ clinicians using the platform, Nabla reports that 55% of users save at least 1 hour per day on documentation with 27% reduction in burnout. Nabla Connect (launched October 2025) enables any EHR vendor to embed Nabla in days via SMART on FHIR.
one_liner: Ambient AI scribe with 35+ languages and zero data storage on servers
best_for: Multi-specialty practices and telehealth providers needing multilingual ambient documentation with strong privacy guarantees and quick EHR integration
not_for: or practices without EHR integration needs (standalone documentation)

pricing.notes: Individual plans historically around $119/month. Enterprise plans $299-399/provider/month. No public pricing since 2026; sales conversation required.

No, Nabla never stores patient data on its servers. Audio, transcripts, and notes exist only in the clinician's browser, providing strong privacy guarantees for both HIPAA and GDPR compliance.
Nabla supports 35+ languages including Arabic, Mandarin, Spanish, French, Hindi, Vietnamese, and many more - making it ideal for diverse patient populations and international telehealth.

faqs.q: Which EHRs does Nabla integrate with?
faqs.a: Nabla integrates with 20+ EHR systems including Epic, Oracle Health (Cerner), athenahealth, NextGen, Greenway, and MEDITECH via SMART on FHIR and Nabla Connect.
